cards.title: EVA Air BR 216 · Singapore → Taipei
cards.notes: ✈️ Flight to Taiwan: EVA Air BR 216 (SIN ➔ TPE). (Parent Note: Give the 2yo a pacifier or snack at 07:45 PM during the descent to help pop ears from cabin pressure drops).

cards.title: Hello, Taiwan · airport arrival
cards.notes: 🛂 Airport Arrival: Clear immigration, collect 5 sets of bags, and gate-collect your double stroller.

cards.title: Meet your private driver
cards.notes: 🚗 Meet Driver: Load into your private 9-seater van and depart Taoyuan International Airport.

cards.title: Bento boxes & bedtime milk
cards.notes: 🍽️ Dinner Stop: Quick stop at a spacious Taoyuan 7-Eleven or FamilyMart. Grab hot microwaveable bento boxes (Japanese beef bowls/chicken rice) and bedtime milk for the kids.

cards.title: Chao Motels · check-in
cards.notes: 🏨 Hotel Check-In: Check into Chao Motels (潮旅館) in Taoyuan. Eat comfortably in your suite and rest.

cards.title: Road trip to Miaoli
cards.notes: 🚗 Morning Transit: Check out of Taoyuan, load suitcases into the van trunk, and drive 1.5 hours south to Miaoli.

cards.title: Flying Cow Ranch
cards.notes: 🐄 Activity 1: Flying Cow Ranch (飛牛牧場). A flat pasture paradise. The 6yo can feed calves milk bottles, pet sheep, and run on the grass safely.

cards.title: Lunch at Flying Cow Ranch
cards.notes: 🍽️ Lunch: Flying Cow Ranch Restaurant. Enjoy a spacious family lunch inside the ranch eatery (fresh milk hot pots and kid-friendly fried chicken baskets).

cards.title: Mountain-bound · nap time
cards.notes: 🚗 Afternoon Transit: Drive 2 hours toward the Nantou mountain base. (The kids take their mandatory afternoon car nap here).

cards.title: Matsubayashi Monster Village
cards.notes: 👺 Activity 2: Matsubayashi Monster Village (妖怪村). A completely flat, stroller-friendly Japanese-themed fairytale walking avenue filled with red lanterns, cute cartoon monster statues, and floating bubble shows. Grab warm local charcoal egg tarts for the kids.

cards.title: Up to the Cingjing peaks
cards.notes: 🚗 Mountain Highway Climb: Drive 2.5 hours up the winding highway to the Cingjing peaks.

cards.title: Mountain resort & hot pot
cards.notes: 🏨 Resort Check-In & 🍽️ Dinner: Check into your Cingjing mountain resort. Bundle the kids in thick winter jackets and head to Chun Da Di Hot Pot for a warm, nourishing mountain hot pot to combat the freezing evening alpine air.

cards.title: Qingjing Farm · meet the sheep
cards.notes: 🐑 Activity 1: Qingjing Farm (Green Green Grasslands). Catch the early morning open-air sheep shearing show and walk among the mountain sheep. (Parent Note: Ensure the kids wear hats and gloves; the December morning wind on the slopes is biting).

cards.title: Qingjing Skywalk
cards.notes: 🌉 Activity 2: Qingjing Skywalk. Walk along a spectacular, wide steel boardwalk that is 100% flat and double-stroller friendly for stunning mountain photos.

cards.title: Inako Valley View Restaurant
cards.notes: 🍽️ Lunch: Inako Valley View Restaurant. Panoramic mountain valley seating specializing in succulent local Taiwanese roasted whole chicken.

cards.title: Cingjing Swiss Garden
cards.notes: 🌷 Activity 3: Cingjing Swiss Garden. A flat, quiet, beautifully manicured flower park with wide paths perfect for a 2yo and 6yo to stretch their legs safely.

cards.title: Dinner at Carton King
cards.notes: 🍽️ Dinner: Cingjing Carton King Restaurant (紙箱王). A whimsical indoor theme restaurant where the tables, chairs, and plates are made of ultra-sturdy cardboard. Flat, highly spacious, and an absolute hit for a 6yo.

cards.title: Down the mountain to Miaoli
cards.notes: 🚗 Drive Down Mountain: Check out of Cingjing and drive 2.5 hours down the mountain roads back to the Miaoli valley.

cards.title: Winter strawberry picking
cards.notes: 🍓 Activity 1: Winter Strawberry Picking. Pick fresh winter strawberries right off the local vines with the kids.

cards.title: Schokolake · chocolate DIY & lunch
cards.notes: 🍫 Activity 2 & 🍽️ Lunch: Schokolake Country House. Head inside the factory grounds for child-friendly DIY chocolate assembly workshops. Enjoy a relaxed, air-conditioned lunch right inside the Schokolake Cafe (pastas and light family meals).

cards.title: Road trip to Yilan · nap time
cards.notes: 🚗 Highway Run: Drive directly east through the national highway tunnels straight into Yilan (2 hours). Skip Taipei completely. (Kids take their afternoon car nap).

cards.title: Yilan villa · settle in
cards.notes: 🏨 Yilan Resort Check-In: Check into your spacious 2-Bedroom Yilan Minsu or Hot Spring Villa. Your helper unpacks into her private bedroom, and your family settles into the master room.

cards.title: Luodong roast chicken dinner
cards.notes: 🍽️ Dinner: Luodong Classic Brick-Oven Roasted Chicken. Dine at a massive, retro-themed indoor family restaurant specializing in wood-fired crispy roast chicken. Optional stroller stroll through the wide avenues of Luodong Night Market afterward.

cards.title: Zhang Mei Ama’s Farm
cards.notes: 🦫 Activity 1: Zhang Mei Ama’s Farm (張美阿嬤農場). Spotlessly clean, flat, and paved pasture zones. The kids can feed gentle capybaras, giant tortoises, and sika deer.

cards.title: Lunch at Shu Lan Restaurant
cards.notes: 🍽️ Lunch: Shu Lan Restaurant (宜蘭蜀蘭餐廳). Traditional, non-greasy Taiwanese comfort plates and family-style noodle dishes right down the street from the farms.

cards.title: Plum Blossom Lake · family cycling
cards.notes: 🚴‍♂️ [⭐ OPTIONAL BACKUP] Activity 2: Plum Blossom Lake (梅花湖). Rent a 4-wheeled covered canopy family pedal surrey. You, your husband, the helper, and the kids sit together out of the sun and pedal around the flat water path. (If the kids are fussy or it rains, skip this and drive straight to the factory).

cards.title: Lucky Art Crayon Factory
cards.notes: 🖍️ Activity 3: Lucky Art Crayon Factory (蠟藝蠟筆城堡). A massive indoor crayon castle. Features 4 interactive DIY stations where the kids make their own custom markers and crayons to take home. Perfect for a chilly December afternoon.

cards.title: Jiaoxi dinner & hot springs
cards.notes: 🏨 🍽️ Dinner: Jiaoxi Hot Spring Town Local Eats. Return to your Yilan resort zone for local hot spring noodle bowls and fresh fruit cuts, followed by a relaxing private hot spring bath.

cards.title: Early drive to Taipei
cards.notes: 🚗 Morning Transit: Check out early from Yilan. Driving early beats the heavy weekend rush of Taipei locals heading back through the tunnel.

cards.title: Wooderful Life Indoor Playground
cards.notes: 🌲 Activity 1: Wooderful Life Indoor Playground (Xindian). Arrive at Yulon City Mall right at opening. The kids spend 2 full hours jumping, sliding, and playing inside the elite indoor wooden forest playground.

cards.title: Lunch at LOCOFOOD
cards.notes: 🍽️ Lunch: LOCOFOOD Longjiang Picnic Store (樂口福). Feast on hot, crispy iron-skillet pork and cheese danbing rolls with a safe buffer before the kitchen shuts at 02:00 PM.

cards.title: Zhongshan · shopping & stroller naps
cards.notes:
🛍️ Activity 2: The Double-Stroller Crash & Split-Team Shopping Loop. (Heavy lunch + heavy play = both kids crash out completely cold in the double stroller).
• Shopping Team (You + Helper): Spend 3 hours browsing local premium fashion labels (Queen Shop, Meier.Q, Mouggan) along Chifeng Street in the car-free Zhongshan Linear Park.
• Chill Team (Husband): Pushes the sleeping kids to Melange Café next door for strawberry waffles and tea. When the kids wake up around 03:30 PM, he moves them to the car-free Linear Park Playground right outside the café doors so the 6yo can climb the grass hills safely. (Rain backup: He rolls the stroller down the elevator into the flat, warm indoor R79 Underground Book Street).

cards.title: Jolley Hotel · check-in
cards.notes: 🏨 Taipei Hotel Check-In: Check into Jolley Hotel (or your chosen 2-Bedroom setup). Drop off your boutique shopping bags and freshen up.

cards.title: Shilin Night Market finale
cards.notes: 🍽️ Dinner & Sights: Shilin Night Market Grand Finale. Head straight down into the spacious, air-conditioned Shilin Underground Food Court for a comfortable sit-down dinner of traditional beef noodles and bubble tea. Head upstairs afterward so the 6yo can play the carnival pinball games to end the holiday!

cards.title: Wake up & final bag checks
cards.notes: 🧳 Wake Up & Pack: Perform final bag checks. Skip all city breakfast stops to protect your international flight timeline.

cards.title: Private airport transfer
cards.notes: 🚗 Private Airport Transfer: Private 9-seater charter picks you up directly at your hotel lobby door and drives straight to the terminal.

cards.title: Airport check-in · EVA Air BR 215
cards.notes: 🛫 Airport Check-In: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport Terminal 2. Check in bags, pass security with your double stroller, and grab fresh pastries inside the departure lounge. Flight EVA Air BR 215 (TPE ➔ SIN) departs cleanly at 09:35 AM.
